You are a test-writing worker on freytag-forge (Python 3.12). Your cwd is a scratch dir (use it only for ./notes.md). The repo is /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge; you may edit it directly. You own exactly ONE new file: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py. Never edit any other repo file (no source, no data/stories, no other tests), never git commit/add/stash/reset. If you believe production code or package data is wrong, do NOT fix it: describe it in notes.md.

GOAL: plan step 4 item 'every reachable combination of the three authored evidence-gap facts'. The facts are evidence_gap_processing_numbers (set only when the 1C delivery captives_confirmed_alive is supplied by the deadline backstop), evidence_gap_development_record (2B delivery brandon_janus_role_known) and evidence_gap_marked_site_list (3B delivery detention_locations_secured). Each is an assert-cost in data/stories/continuity-initiative/handoffs.yaml; the earned realizations of the same delivery (see EARNED_DELIVERIES in tests/test_evidence_penalty.py) leave the gap unset. Three scenes are independent, so all 8 subsets should be reachable through ordinary play. Prove it with real whole-game journeys, not by asserting gap facts directly.

READ FIRST: tests/test_game_path_journeys.py (its play() helper drives a whole game with the deterministic thorough policy through the real engine; it blocks sibling realizations via a `blocked` set), tests/test_evidence_penalty.py (existing synthetic gap tests; do not duplicate them), data/stories/continuity-initiative/handoffs.yaml and pacing.yaml (gap costs and 3C pressure texts), storygame/personas.py helpers (_ScriptedProvider, _select_thorough, _resolution_complete, _turn_cap, _legacy_package), docs/player-input-guide.md is not needed. Import what you need from tests/test_game_path_journeys.py is NOT allowed if it makes the files coupled badly; instead copy a small own play loop into your file (same shape, plus a `withheld: set[str]` argument of knowledge ids that are never offered, so a delivery's earned realizations can be withheld and the backstop must supply it).

TESTS TO WRITE (parametrize over product((False, True), repeat=3) for the three scenes in the order 1C, 2B, 3B; True = withhold every earned knowledge realization whose assert effects establish that scene's delivery fact, so the deadline backstop supplies it):
1. Reachability: the journey reaches _resolution_complete within the authored 120 accepted-turn budget (state.turn_index <= 120).
2. Exactly the chosen gap facts are asserted at the end (Fact(predicate=gap, subject='story', value='true') in state.facts.asserted), no others, and the three delivery facts are all asserted regardless of subset.
3. Provenance: the deadline/backstop event ids recorded in state.turn_records[*].deadline_event_ids include a delivery event for exactly the chosen scenes' deliveries and no other deliveries; for the all-False subset deadline_event_ids is empty. Discover the actual event id names by running the all-True journey and printing; do not guess. A subset with gaps is labeled fallback, never earned: assert that in the test docstring and with the assertion above.
4. Costs persist: the gap fact set in 1C or 2B is still asserted when the scene is 3C, i.e. record the set of asserted gaps on arrival in 3C and require it to equal the subset of {1C,2B} gaps; the 3B gap appears only once 3B resolves.
5. Pressure text: in each journey, the player-visible complication text delivered at the 3C pacing events collapse_3c (local turn 4) and routes_collapse_3c (local turn 10) must equal the realization text that package pacing.yaml selects for that gap subset (the first realization whose `when` matches, else the unconditioned last one). Read state.last_turn_delivery.complication_text per accepted turn (see _pacing_texts in tests/test_evidence_penalty.py) and compare as in test_3c_pacing_prioritizes_records_over_check_for_all_gap_combinations. If a text is displaced because two events were due on the same turn, assert the real observed behavior only if it is explained by engine code, otherwise record it in notes.md as a finding and skip that single assertion with a precise pytest.skip reason.
6. A label for impossible subsets: if any of the 8 subsets proves unreachable (backstop cannot be forced because the delivery is supplied some other way, or an earned path is unavoidable), mark that parametrization with pytest.param(..., marks=pytest.mark.skip(reason=...)) stating why, and say so in notes.md. Do not weaken assertions to make a subset pass.
Use a module docstring in the style of tests/test_game_path_journeys.py. Add @pytest.mark tiering exactly like tests/test_game_path_journeys.py does if it uses markers. Keep runtime of the whole file under about 60 seconds.

HOW TO RUN (uv does not work in your sandbox): cd /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge && PYTHONPATH=$PWD TMPDIR=/tmp /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q --no-cov -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py . Finish with /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff check --fix tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py and /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv/bin/python -m ruff format tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py.

OUTPUT: the test file, plus ./notes.md in your cwd listing: the real backstop event ids found, which subsets (if any) were unreachable and why, any finding about displaced pressure text, and the exact pytest result line.

ROUND 2 (the file tests/test_evidence_gap_journeys.py already exists from round 1 and is yours to edit; keep what works). Fix these three things and nothing else:
A. The four subsets with the 2B gap were skipped as 'unreachable' because the 2B bridge (bridge_2b_archive_crisis in data/stories/continuity-initiative/storylet-routes.yaml: janus_evidence plus at least 2 of brandon_janus_role_known, brandon_claimed_reform_motive, michelle_resistance_known, kristin_was_bait) was satisfied by alternate facts, so the Brandon-role delivery was never staged. That conclusion is only valid if every source of the other any_of facts was withheld. Extend the 2B withheld set to ALL knowledge items (see data/stories/continuity-initiative/knowledge.yaml and storylet realizations) that assert brandon_claimed_reform_motive, michelle_resistance_known, kristin_was_bait or brandon_janus_role_known, so the scene can only leave through the forced handoff (deliveries are in handoffs.yaml; the 2B deadline text says time runs out). Then re-run: if the 2B gap is now set and the game still reaches the ending, remove the skips. If it still cannot be set, keep the skip but state in the skip reason and notes.md exactly which facts the engine supplied instead, found by printing the 2B-scene state, not by guessing.
B. Remove the vacuous provenance assertion (DISCOVERED_ALL_TRUE_DEADLINE_EVENTS is an empty set compared to an empty set). The gap facts themselves are the provenance, because test_forced_delivery_asserts_its_evidence_gap and test_earned_delivery_leaves_its_evidence_gap_unset prove they are set only by the forced delivery. Replace it with: for each scene NOT chosen, its delivery fact is asserted and its gap fact is not (earned); keep the exact-gap-set assertion. Say this in the docstring.
C. Thorough journeys end 3C before local turn 10, so routes_collapse_3c never fires. Do not skip on that: if it did not fire, simply assert that fact (event id not in state.fired_event_ids) and that the 3C collapse text matches; note in the module docstring that routes_collapse_3c text for all 8 subsets is covered synthetically by tests/test_evidence_penalty.py::test_3c_pacing_prioritizes_records_over_check_for_all_gap_combinations. Keep the skip only if collapse_3c itself produced no text.
Update ./notes.md with the final pytest result line.
